title: Co-founder and CEO
segment: Fintech: fraud and financial-crime platform with an in-house transaction foundation model
icp_segment: (a) trains own models (card or transaction foundation model)
top_signal: Launched Sardine AI Labs (30 Sep 2026; FinTech Global 5 Oct 2026), an applied research group for foundation models against financial crime. It released early results from a card foundation model, a transformer pretrained on about 1B transactions from 12+ issuers, reporting +68% fraud-detection accuracy on issuers excluded from training. The research agenda covers extremely long transaction-sequence modelling, and the lab offers $375K in fellowships. Sardine's network covers 6.6B transactions and $1.8T TPV. It is hiring Applied AI Research Scientists.

why_now: A newly formed lab is moving from a 1B-transaction pilot model to long-sequence pretraining across a 6.6B-transaction network, a training step-up that fits a 12-month block from Feb-May 2027. Founder-led, with more than $70M raised ($19.5M Series A plus $51M Series B in 2022, plus a Series C whose amount was not checked this session). Caveat: GPU scale is not stated publicly.
